settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors a Keilhauer dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized Keilhauer dealer serving Ontario. We supply, quote, deliver, and install the Keilhauer lines we carry — boardroom and conference chairs, lounge seating, task seating, and tables — for institutional and workplace clients, with delivery and installation by our own Ontario crew.

settings.question: Where is Keilhauer furniture made?
settings.answer: Keilhauer manufactures its products in Toronto, Ontario, and has been Canadian-owned and operated since 1981. Buying Canadian-made keeps lead times shorter than imported alternatives and means post-sale service and replacement parts do not require cross-border coordination.

settings.question: What warranty do Keilhauer products carry?
settings.answer: Keilhauer warrants its products against defects in materials and workmanship for 10 years under standard single-shift use — covering desk, conference and task chairs, lounge seating, and tables — with textiles warranted for 1 year. For heavy use above 40 hours per week the furniture warranty is 5 years. As your authorized dealer, Brant Business Interiors files warranty claims directly with Keilhauer on your behalf.

settings.question: Can I specify custom fabric or my own material (COM)?
settings.answer: Yes — Keilhauer offers a broad fabric library and supports COM (customer’s own material) on most upholstered products. Send us your fabric specification and we will confirm Keilhauer’s COM requirements — rub count, application, and yardage — and the lead time before your purchase order is issued.

settings.question: Are Keilhauer products available to OECM buyers?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender. Family-owned and supplying Ontario workplaces since 1964, from 701 The Queensway, Units 2-4, Peterborough, ON K9J 7J6.
